langkah.js: (async()=>{const a=performance.now();while(!document.querySelector('.nr-top3__item')){await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));}const b=performance.now();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));for(let i=0;i<160;i++){const t=[...document.querySelectorAll('img.leaflet-tile')];if(t.length&&t.every(x=>x.classList.contains('leaflet-tile-loaded')))return 'hasil '+Math.round(b-a)+' ms, ubin lengkap '+Math.round(performance.now()-b)+' ms setelah hasil';await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,250));}return 'timeout';})()
